qa.stranded_dragonair.1.b1: A fisher at the lake shore says a Dragonair has been circling the same rocks for days, too weak to leave.
qa.stranded_dragonair.1.b2: You find it caught in an old net, scales dull. It does not flee when you come close.
qa.stranded_dragonair.2.b1: You bring berries and clean water each time you pass. The Dragonair's scales start to shine again.
qa.stranded_dragonair.2.b2: Today it slips free of the last strands of net and rises over the water, calling once.
qa.stranded_dragonair.3.b1: At the lake's edge a small Dratini waits where the Dragonair used to circle.
qa.stranded_dragonair.3.b2: The Dragonair watches from the water as the Dratini follows you. It seems to be saying thank you. Dratini can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
qa.peak_alpha.1.b1: Climbers whisper about an Alpha that rules the highest peak, and a little Bagon that keeps leaping at it from the cliffs.
qa.peak_alpha.1.b2: You climb until the air is thin. On the summit the Alpha roars, and the Bagon jumps again.
qa.peak_alpha.2.b1: You face the Alpha together with the tiny Bagon at your side. When the dust settles, the Alpha bows its head and leaves the peak.
qa.peak_alpha.2.b2: Bagon stands at the cliff edge and, for once, does not jump. It looks at you instead. Bagon can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
qa.ironvein_prototype.1.b1: In an abandoned Ironvein Combine lab, one console is still blinking. Something metal hums behind the glass.
qa.ironvein_prototype.1.b2: A Beldum floats in a sealed chamber, labelled PROTOTYPE 0. Its eye follows you.
qa.ironvein_prototype.2.b1: You find the lab's override code in a dusty notebook. The chamber hisses open.
qa.ironvein_prototype.2.b2: Beldum hovers out, studies you for a long moment, and settles beside you. Beldum can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
qa.fed_three_nights.1.b1: A wild Gible keeps watching your camp from a sandy burrow, too wary to come close.
qa.fed_three_nights.1.b2: You leave a share of food at the burrow's mouth. In the morning it is gone.
qa.fed_three_nights.2.b1: The Gible is back, closer this time. You leave food again, and it eats while you watch.
qa.fed_three_nights.2.b2: It bites your bag on the way out. You decide to take that as friendship.
qa.fed_three_nights.3.b1: On the third night the Gible walks right into camp and curls up by the fire.
qa.fed_three_nights.3.b2: It is still asleep there when you pack up, and it follows you down the road. Gible can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
qa.choir_ritual.1.b1: At a Hollow Choir ritual site, the singing stops when you arrive. In the middle of the circle, a feral Deino is chained to a stone.
qa.choir_ritual.1.b2: The chanters scatter into the dark. The Deino snaps at every sound.
qa.choir_ritual.2.b1: You speak to it, softly, until it stops snapping and listens to your voice. The chain falls away.
qa.choir_ritual.2.b2: Deino follows the sound of your steps out of the ruin. Deino can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
qa.rain_night.1.b1: On a night of heavy rain, something small and slimy is huddled under your tent flap.
qa.rain_night.1.b2: A Goomy, shivering, though it is made of rain. It seems to have run from a bigger Pokémon.
qa.rain_night.2.b1: You let it stay dry beside you until morning. When the rain stops, it does not leave.
qa.rain_night.2.b2: Goomy slides after you, leaving a shiny trail, and seems quite proud of it. Goomy can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
qa.training_camp.1.b1: Your rival invites you to a mountain training camp. A young Jangmo-o is challenging every Pokémon there.
qa.training_camp.1.b2: Your rival grins. "That one has fire. Think you can keep up with it?"
qa.training_camp.2.b1: You train with the Jangmo-o for three days. On the last, it clangs its scales at you and refuses to stay behind.
qa.training_camp.2.b2: Your rival laughs. "Looks like it picked you." Jangmo-o can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
qa.lost_dreepy.1.b1: At dusk a Dreepy drifts into camp, looking for something it cannot name.
qa.lost_dreepy.1.b2: It keeps floating toward the hills, then back to you, as if asking you to come.
qa.lost_dreepy.2.b1: You follow it to an old shrine, lit by ghost-fire. Other Dreepy flicker in the dark.
qa.lost_dreepy.2.b2: One of them is its parent, a tired Dragapult. The family circles you once.
qa.lost_dreepy.3.b1: The Dragapult sends the little Dreepy back to you. It has decided you are its family now too.
qa.lost_dreepy.3.b2: Dreepy settles in your bag as if it has always been there. Dreepy can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
qa.long_winter.1.b1: Snow falls in the middle of summer on a mountain route. People call it the Long Winter, and they say a Frigibax causes it.
qa.long_winter.1.b2: You find an Alpha Baxcalibur guarding the pass, and a small Frigibax hiding behind it.
qa.long_winter.2.b1: The Alpha is old and tired. When you stand your ground, it lets the snow stop and lies down to rest.
qa.long_winter.2.b2: The little Frigibax waddles to you, and the pass begins to thaw. Frigibax can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
qa.lucky_egg.1.b1: A Pokémon Breeder hands you a spotted egg. "It needs a calm road and a kind team. Can you carry it a while?"
qa.lucky_egg.1.b2: The egg is warm and wobbles when the team is near.
qa.lucky_egg.2.b1: You keep the egg close through every fight, never letting it get bumped.
qa.lucky_egg.2.b2: At night you can hear a faint tapping from inside.
qa.lucky_egg.3.b1: The shell cracks open and a Togepi tumbles out, giggling at the first thing it sees: you.
qa.lucky_egg.3.b2: The Breeder smiles. "It chose well." Togepi can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
qa.twin_burrow.1.b1: A sinkhole has opened in a field. Two Nidoran, one blue and one purple, are trapped at the bottom.
qa.twin_burrow.1.b2: They are trying to push each other up and both keep sliding back down.
qa.twin_burrow.2.b1: You lower a rope and lift them out, one after the other. They will not leave each other's side.
qa.twin_burrow.2.b2: Both of them follow you, and neither will go without the other. Nidoran♀ and Nidoran♂ can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
qa.lantern_vigil.1.b1: In an old graveyard, the lanterns go out one by one each night. A caretaker asks you to keep the first one lit.
qa.lantern_vigil.1.b2: You keep watch. Near midnight, a Duskull drifts by and stares into your lantern.
qa.lantern_vigil.2.b1: At the second lantern the Duskull is waiting for you. It helps you keep the flame from the wind.
qa.lantern_vigil.2.b2: The caretaker says nobody has seen a Duskull help before.
qa.lantern_vigil.3.b1: At the last lantern, the Duskull shows you an old grave with your family's name on it, then waits beside you.
qa.lantern_vigil.3.b2: When dawn comes, it follows you out of the graveyard. Duskull can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
qa.retired_uniform.1.b1: After you beat a squad of grunts, a Pawniard steps out of their camp, wearing a scrap of an old team uniform.
qa.retired_uniform.1.b2: It salutes you, the way it was taught to salute its old boss.
qa.retired_uniform.2.b1: You take the scrap of uniform from it and fold it away. The Pawniard looks lost, then stands at your side instead.
qa.retired_uniform.2.b2: It does not wait for orders. It chose you. Pawniard can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
